newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P affirms long and short-term ratings on Nomura.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms long and short-term ratings on Nomura.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Friday it has affirmed its "A+" long-term and "A-1" short-term ratings on Nomura Securities Co Ltd and affiliates.
The outlook remains negative, the credit rating firm added.
The affirmation of the ratings followed penalties imposed on Japan's biggest brokerage by the Ministry of Finance.

S&P said that the punishment, which included suspension of proprietary trading of equity and equity-linked products from August 6 through the end of 1997 and the suspension of equity-related trading at all branches for five days, would not significantly damage Nomura's earnings and business franchise.

The credit rating firm said that the rating outlook was nevertheless negative as the Japanese securities industry faced a tougher environment due to full-scale deregulation and increasing competition.
Nomura's affiliates rated by S&P include Nomura Holding America Inc and Nomura Bank International Plc.
